atoms.summary: CF Pages domain attach via API does not auto-reconcile existing DNS — must delete conflicting record and create proxied CNAME to <project>.pages.dev manually; ~30s cert window can 522
Pages _headers: comments must sit above the path block; ship short HSTS (3600) during migration for reversibility, raise post-soak; Cache-Control must-revalidate for single-file apps
eclear.codyssey.com migrated nginx(oracle-il-micro) -> Cloudflare Pages; vhost+docroot decommissioned; Gitea Actions auto-deploys html/ on push
Sanitizer pipelines: use one positive URL-scheme allowlist shared by every output path — a markdown re-render path can reintroduce schemes the HTML path stripped
This machine wipes ~/.cache/ms-playwright between sessions — npx playwright install chromium needed fresh each time; /tmp scripts can't resolve repo node_modules
Org CF Pages static migration pattern validated twice: _headers + wrangler deploy + domain attach + manual CNAME swap + retire origin; Pages Edit+DNS Edit+Zone Read token suffices
